newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian shares on positive note ahead FOMC.
newsitem.headline: Belgian shares on positive note ahead FOMC.

text.p: Selected blue chip buying took Brussels Bel-20 Index .BFX into positive territory in early Monday dealings, though dealers said it was too early to say if the market could revisit recent highs.
"I have the feeling everyone is watching New York for the moment," one trader said, referring to the two-day meeting of the U.S. Federal Reserve's policy making committee that starts Tuesday.
The Bel-20 was up 6.63 points, or 0.3 percent, at 2,379.80 points at 0850 GMT after a half hour's trade. The opening of the market had earlier been delayed until 0820 GMT.

Ten Bel-20 blue chips were lower, nine were up and one was unchanged. Gainers included index heavyweights Kredietbank, up 125 francs at 14,600, and chemicals group UCB, up 100 francs at 116,200 francs.
Electronics company Barco also extended the gains it has made since dipping to 6,650 francs on June 17. Barco was up 90 francs at 7,170 by 0850 GMT after earlier setting a life high at 7,200 francs.
Barco's gains helped its majority shareholder GIMV GIMV.BR, which was introduced to the bourse last week. GIMV was up 30 francs, or 1.43 percent, at 2,130 francs.
Bel-20 losers included oil and gas group PetroFina which posted strong gains last week. Holding company Groupe Bruxelles Lambert was 20 francs lower at 6,070.
Outside the Bel-20, GBL's parent company CNP/NPM was up 10 francs at 2,730 francs in unusual large volume of 37,653 shares.
One trader said he was unaware of any reason for the movement.
